text:
Predicates:
Podcast(x) ::: x is a podcast.
Novel(x) ::: x is a novel.
BornIn(x, y) ::: x was born in y.
American(x) ::: x is American.
WrittenBy(x, y) ::: x is written by y.
Author(x, y) ::: x is the author of y.
Book(x) ::: x is a book.
Create(x, y) ::: x created y.
PublishedIn(y, z) ::: y was published in year z.
City(y) ::: y is a city.
Specialize(x, y) ::: x specializes in y.
Write(x, y) ::: x wrote y.
FamilyHistory ::: Family History.
DaniShapiro ::: Dani Shapiro.
FamilySecrets ::: Family Secrets.
Boston ::: Boston.
Year(2003) ::: 2003.
Premises:
Podcast(not_a_novel) ::: A podcast is not a novel.
BornIn(DaniShapiro, Boston) ::: Dani Shapiro was born in Boston.
American(DaniShapiro) ::: Dani Shapiro is American.
Book(FamilyHistory) ∧ Write(DaniShapiro, FamilyHistory) ::: Family History is written by Dani Shapiro.
PublishedIn(FamilyHistory, 2003) ::: Family History was written in 2003.
Create(DaniShapiro, FamilySecrets) ::: Dani Shapiro created Family Secrets.
City(Boston) ::: Boston is a city.
∃x (Author(x, FamilyHistory) ∧ Book(FamilyHistory)) ::: Someone authored Family History.
∃x (Author(x, FamilySecrets) ∧ Create(x, FamilySecrets)) ::: Someone created Family Secrets.
Conclusion:
FamilySecrets ::: Family Secrets.
Novel(FamilySecrets) ::: Family Secrets is a novel.
